Package on BJP/BAR/MUL/DW-212. TID- 593255 under Important Rural Infrastructure Development Project Barishal Jhalokathi Perojpur BJP the agreement between Procuring Entity Office of the Executive Engineer LGED Barishal and Your Company M/S Faruk and Brothers was signed on 11.10.21. According to the agreement the work start date was 18.10.21 and completion date was 18.07.22. After starting the work you stopped the work more than 28 days which was very disappointing. You have been told to start up the work several times both formally and informally. Still you did not start the work at all. So 28 day final Letter was issued for your failure memo no 46.02.0600.000.14.192.21.2199. But you did not respond to the letter and you did not start the work again. As a fundamental breach of contract for stopping the work for more than 28 days the PE asked to PD for administrative approval to cancel the work Memo No 46.02.0600.000.14.192.21.3318. After that PD gave administrative approval to cancel the work memo no 46.02.0000.918.16.01.22.48. He also told to take necessary steps for license debarment. Finally for fundamental breach of contract Your work has been cancelled by PE as per Tender document GCC Clause 36.1bi memo no 46.02.0600.14.192.21.6293. Therefore according to PPR-2008 article 1274 also your license will be debarred for 02 Two years as a punishment from attending any tender under LGED. You are requested to give proper explanation against your failure to complete the work and why the authority should not debar your license.
